description: Land Acquisition - Athiliwewa, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains orders for taking possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. The mention of the Minister's name and title is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being the primary focus of the gazette, which centers on property acquisition and land administration.
